svg.title: VisionIQ 03 - LEARN knowledge base pipeline
svg.text: Permission-aware engineering memory. Source systems stay authoritative; VisionIQ keeps attributed, versioned copies.
• Redact before indexing or model use
• Parse links, files, symbols, test names
• AI proposes symptom and cause labels
• Bad build → roll back to last good
• Feedback kept apart from test evidence
• Reverts and incidents can downgrade a
Brief · Defect deep path · Enhancement guidance · Impact Agent history view
• Missing cause = unverified, never filled in
